headline: exists_and_consistent
headline_meaning: Registered in Singapore, and public sources agree it is the company named.

brief.validity_reasoning: Multiple independent sources (registry record, corporate website, career page, job posting) consistently describe ComfortDelGro Corporation Limited as a live Singapore public company and provide details about its operations and the Bus Captain role.

key_facts.claim: Legal name is COMFORTDELGRO CORPORATION LIMITED
Company is a live public company incorporated on 1 January 2003
Registered business activity is INVESTMENT HOLDING COMPANY (SSIC 64202)

evidence.quote: Registered business activity: INVESTMENT HOLDING COMPANY
Primary User Described Activity: INVESTMENT HOLDING COMPANY

key_facts.claim: ComfortDelGro operates a large land‑transport business with buses, rail and taxis

evidence.quote: multinational land transport operator ... runs public buses, rail lines, taxis and point‑to‑point mobility services
Comfortdelgro is a leading bus and rail operator in Singapore, managing over 200 bus services

key_facts.claim: Bus Captain role is a full‑time, 44‑hour/week position reporting to Operations Supervisor

evidence.quote: Full Time: 44 hours/ week, 6‑day work week
Report to the Operations Supervisor directly

key_facts.claim: Bus Captain must hold a valid Class 4 vehicle licence and at least 1 year driving experience

evidence.quote: Must possess valid Class 4 vehicle license

key_facts.claim: Benefits for bus captains include sign‑on bonus up to S$3,000 and monthly reliability incentive up to S$300

evidence.quote: Sign‑on bonus (up to S$3,000 for new bus captains)
Monthly reliability incentive up to S$300

key_facts.claim: ComfortDelGro has over 24,500 employees in 13 countries and a fleet of about 54,000 vehicles

evidence.quote: With over 24,500 employees in 13 countries, we’re moving the world safely
global fleet of 54,000, from taxis to bus and rail services

positive_signals.claim: Company is listed on SGX (ticker C52) and regularly publishes announcements
Recent senior‑leadership succession plan announced for 2026
